user_prompt: We need to ensure our supply chain partners can deliver the materials we need on time and at the right cost. Our goal is to have complete visibility into what we've committed to buy from each supplier and be confident that those commitments will be fulfilled according to our specifications.

steps.step_name: We need to ensure our supply chain partners can deliver the materials we need on time and at the right cost. Our goal is to have complete visibility into what we've committed to buy from each supplier and be confident that those commitments will be fulfilled according to our specifications.

method_trace.picked_reason: This resource directly addresses all aspects of the activity: it manages purchase orders and vendor commitments, provides real-time visibility into supplier relationships and order status, tracks order fulfillment against specifications, coordinates delivery schedules to ensure on-time delivery, manages vendor contracts for cost management, and tracks vendor performance. It exposes both PurchaseOrder and Vendor entity types with comprehensive capabilities including manage-purchase-orders, coordinate-delivery-schedules, track-order-fulfillment, manage-vendor-contracts, and track-vendor-performance—covering the full spectrum of supply chain partner visibility and commitment fulfillment requirements.
